reviews.x: Tiny flakes of glitter, colors are not the same as what's in the photo. These are very translucent. Perhaps it's the camera because even my photo doesn't show how translucent they are...

Extremely surprised at how much glitter you get in each container! Great value..and I just do my nails at home for fun. Stick em on with a clear coat of polish, then another coat over the glitter to hold em in place. Can't get much easier then that.

reviews.t: Nice colors but very small containers
reviews.x: I don't know why some are saying there's so much glitter ? In fact it's very little but I guess you get what've pay for!  The colors are great I do love the different colors! It arrived 8 days earlier !

These are big pieces of glitter, so great for individual placement.  The colors are really nice.  The size is great for the price.  Each container should last at least 10 manicures, unless you are doing every nail with the glitter.  Don't be fooled and think this is fine glitter they are large pieces, so better for accent designs.
Lovvvvvvvvveeee the glitter! Can you tell I'm excited? Haha! The glitter arrived way before expected and I love the glitter choices they sent! I'm going to have fun dolling up my nails. Thank you!
IN LOVE with this glitter. It looks SO great, like a mermaid's tail. I just used the green for St. Patrick's Day, and it was gorgeous. Sticks really well and doesn't flake off.

Does anyone have a problem with these sticking? I used on my shellac manicure. Just put on the last tacky layer then put my top coat on. Cured under UV light and noticed the shellac doesn't stick to the glitter. I put on another top coat and same thing happened. The ones that did stick ended up peeling off because they don't sit completely flush with your nail. Am I doing something wrong or are they just that bad?

The sequins are smaller than I expected, but they are indeed hexagon shaped sequins and they look very nice on my nails! The cases they come in are super sturdy and nice too, and they look very neat stacked up at my nail painting area. All in all a nice product. My only complaint is that many of the colors also had shavings and glitter dust in with the sequins and that made it difficult to properly place them.

reviews.t: very good price and the glitter is pretty good
reviews.x: very good price and the glitter is pretty good, but I was missing one container! i'm not sure what color is missing, as the colors i got did not exactly match the picture. also about 25% of the glitter is is not hexagon; they are either broken/cut in half. but for the price, I am mostly satisfied.

reviews.t: I would definitely buy over and over and over again!
reviews.x: They are super pretty and you get a great amount. Beautiful packaging too. Takes awhile to arrive, but for me that's ok. The piece shapes are a great size, and you get awesome colors.These are loose glitter pieces so adhere them wit a clear polish.

claims.text: Many reviewers love the colors and find the glitter pretty, though some note colors differ from the photos or are sheer/translucent.
Opinions on quantity are split: several say there is a lot of glitter per container and good value, while others find the containers tiny with very little product.
The glitter pieces are large hexagon shapes, which some find great for individual placement but others find bigger or smaller than expected and unsuitable for dipping.
Adhesion is mixed: some say it sticks well and doesn't flake off, while others report it doesn't stay on, especially over shellac.
Shipping is often faster than expected, though one reviewer notes it takes a while coming from China.
